findings.desc: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:4972-5034 exact-mapping mutation false-green: collectLiteralDoneOracleRowIds accepts every literal id property anywhere in done-oracle.ts, and checkDonePreflightPredicateInventory verifies only that the declared row id exists, not that the row emits the mapped blocker code or consumes the corresponding predicate. Executing the exact checker functions in memory with future_done_predicate mapped to the unrelated existing test-evidence row and artifact:delivery-check.json returned errors:[]; therefore a future DONE predicate can be added, falsely mapped to an unrelated row, and the promised omission guard still passes while done_prepare remains divergent. This directly violates CHK-003 and can make lifecycle readiness evidence misleading; require the checker/mutation test to reject wrong-row mappings by proving code-to-row/predicate correspondence, not mere set membership.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed by proof-or-stop-implementer commit 2480d37f8b1cd4845c0bb79415cc68c9314c8dba. Executable mutations now prove an unrelated existing row and a row-local wrong predicate are both rejected; exact blocker-to-oracle correspondence is checked. Owner reran node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs and node packages/main/tests/red/red-done-prepare-done-parity.mjs successfully, then refreshed all pinned verification evidence.

findings.desc: doc-promise-undelivered: docs/requirements/decisions/done-prepare-automation-execution-plan.md:163-168 promises that DONE/preflight parity is mechanically guarded, but scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:4972-5034 collects every literal id anywhere in done-oracle.ts and checks only row-id set membership. A future literal DONE blocker can therefore be mapped to an unrelated existing row/process fact and the verifier passes without done_prepare consuming that predicate; the in-memory test at 5062-5074 covers only an entirely unmapped code. This leaves the advertised future-divergence guard incomplete and can again make DONE readiness evidence misleading. Require a wrong-row/wrong-predicate mutation to fail by mechanically binding each blocker code to the corresponding oracle predicate/row behavior. Same root cause independently registered as B-212f:F-001.
